SELECT yp.youth_policy_id AS youthPolicyId, yp.policy_name AS policyName, yp.policy_keyword AS policyKeyword, yp.policy_description AS policyDescription, yp.support_content AS supportContent, yp.provider_institution_name AS providerInstitutionName, yp.application_start_date AS applicationStartDate, yp.application_end_date AS applicationEndDate, yp.application_period_text AS applicationPeriodText, yp.min_age AS minAge, yp.max_age AS maxAge, yp.min_income AS minIncome, yp.max_income AS maxIncome, yp.income_condition_text AS incomeConditionText, yp.qualification AS qualification, yp.application_method AS applicationMethod, yp.application_url AS applicationUrl, yp.reference_url AS referenceUrl FROM youth_policy yp WHERE yp.youth_policy_id = #{youthPolicyId}
